item.title: AMD AI revenue surges in record quarter
item.summary: AMD reported record second-quarter 2026 revenue of $11.5 billion, up 50% year on year and 13% from the previous quarter, as demand for its data center processors and AI accelerators continued to rise. The chipmaker posted GAAP net income of $2.3 billion, with diluted earnings of $1.38 per share.
